name: +1 Speed Butter Escape🧈
desc:
🧈 Welcome to +1 Speed Butter Escape🧈

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed
👟 Jump, speed up, and win in an obby made of squishy butter!
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful items & multipliers
👥 Race against your friends and other players from all around world.
🌍 Compete and climb the global rankings on the leaderboard!
🚀 Always be fast! But the slightest mistake will send you back to the start.😱

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing candy sounds for a perfect mix of speed & chill ✨
